card.name: "Least" and "and" in timing phrases
card.fires_on: The word "least" in "at least" before a time span, and "and" or "and/or" in lists of timing or route such as "before, during, and after".

modes.label: at least + duration
modes.description: The word "least" in "at least" just before a number of minutes, days, weeks or months.
modes.example: Inability to stand or sit upright for at<< least>> 30 minutes [ see Dosage

modes.label: and in timing or route lists
modes.description: The word "and" ending a list of timing points or routes of giving a drug.

card.plain: It marks the word "least" or "and" in phrases that set how long or when something applies around treatment.
